amulets.name: Minor Aetheric Amulet
amulets.description: A small Aetherstone shard wrapped in copper wire. Protects against minor Aetheric interference.

amulets.name: Lightstone Amulet
amulets.description: Aether-powered amulet that emits a steady glow. Repels shadow-aligned creatures and casts a halo in dark places.

amulets.name: Mud Warden Amulet
amulets.description: Worn by Mud Warden patrols. Grants brief protection from the corrosive runoff of the Mud Seas.

amulets.name: Aetheric Diadem
amulets.description: A delicate diadem cored with refined Aetherstone. Sharpens the channeller's focus.

amulets.name: Whisperer's Charm
amulets.description: A small charm carved from Aether-treated bone. Calms animals and softens hostile NPCs slightly.

amulets.name: Aetheric Locket
amulets.description: A pre-flood pendant of Aether-veined silver. Hums when held close to a relic — the warmer the hum, the closer the find. The bearer reads the world a half-beat clearer.

amulets.name: Lich Phylactery
amulets.description: Lich Phylactery. A bone-clasped vial of cold Aetheric fluid — the half-soul the Lich could never quite finish hiding. Hums against the breastbone.

amulets.name: Bog-Heart Pearl
amulets.description: Bog-Heart Pearl. A black pearl pulled from the gullet of the Bog Wyrm, still warm. Holds the wyrm's tolerance for the venom it lived in.

amulets.name: Mud Gem Amulet
amulets.description: Mud Gem Amulet. A polished Mud Gem set in spider-silk wire. Hums when Aetheric weather closes in — a half-warning, a half-blessing.

amulets.name: Lich-Heart Pendant
amulets.description: Lich-Heart Pendant. An Aetherstone heart wrapped in Aetheric cloth — cold to the touch, colder to the wearer's thoughts. Sharpens recall to a blade.

amulets.name: Behemoth-Heart Talisman
amulets.description: Behemoth-Heart Talisman. A fist-sized chunk of Behemoth heart, dried and lacquered. Steadies the bearer's swing, slows their breath.

amulets.name: Amulet of the Silt Warden
amulets.description: A mudstone talisman the silt-wardens wore against the flood's rot. It steadies the wearer and turns aside creeping poison and corruption.

amulets.name: Reclaimer's Aegis Pendant
amulets.description: Scrap-forged and stamped with the Reclaimers' mark — a broad plate over the sternum that has turned more than one blade, and shrugs off the glow of a hot ruin.

amulets.name: Heart of the Aetherstorm
amulets.description: A boss-heart bound in copper and glass, forever mid-discharge. The storm inside sharpens the wearer's mind, sheaths them in a faint ward, and drinks the worst of aether and flame.

amulets.name: Rustbane Charm
amulets.description: A knot of oiled cloth and salt on a leather thong. Scavengers swear by it; the rot of the buried country keeps its distance.

amulets.name: Silt-Diver's Pendant
amulets.description: Carved from a swamp-tortoise’s inner shell by divers who work the drowned levels. Light in the water, and the mud’s poison slides off it.

amulets.name: Emberheart Locket
amulets.description: A coal that has been burning inside a glass case for longer than anyone can account for. It keeps the heat off the wearer and lends it to the wearer’s edge.

amulets.name: Warden's Bulwark Pendant
amulets.description: A gate-warden’s plate on a short chain, sized to sit flat over the sternum. It has stopped things. You can see where.

amulets.name: Amulet of the Cold Star
amulets.description: A shard of something that fell a long way and has not finished cooling. Once in a fight it remembers the fall, and the cold of it reaches further than a thrown spear.

amulets.name: Nightglass Pendant
amulets.description: Black glass with nothing behind it, not even a reflection. Wearing it, you are harder to find, and what you do when you are not found is worse.
